definitions.explanation: A national holiday on May 5, one of the days of Golden Week, set aside for children's happiness and growth. It falls on the old Boys' Festival, {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}.

examples.japanese: こどもの{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧だ。
こどもの{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げた→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We flew carp streamers on Children's Day.

examples.japanese: こどもの{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、{菖蒲湯|しょうぶゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On Children's Day many families eat kashiwa-mochi and take an iris bath.

notes:
Written with hiragana こども, not ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧, in the official name of the holiday.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The day keeps the customs of ⟦{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}→端午の節句：16518_tangonosekku⟧, which celebrated boys: families fly ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧ (carp streamers), display a samurai helmet or armor (⟦{五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}→五月人形：27110_gogatsuningyou⟧), and eat ⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧ or ⟦ちまき→ちまき：17624_chimaki⟧. Girls have their own day, {雛祭|ひなまつ}り on March 3, which is not a holiday.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}→端午の節句：16518_tangonosekku⟧: the traditional Boys' Festival on the same date
- ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧: Golden Week, the string of holidays it ends
